### Boundary Abstraction

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| declared_starting_condition | Actual burden-bearing separately supplied virgin graded mineral, whole binder/filler and real utilities/maintenance at declared receipt gates |
| starting_condition_role | supplied_material |
| product_classification_scope | CPC 3.0:37940; narrower |
| recursive_input_rule | No purchased finished mix shortcut; internal same-cohort fines or permitted work retain vectors and cancel once. External RAP/recovered feed requires separate applicability and upstream/recycling decision. |
| upstream_dataset_requirement | One compatible whole-supply/provider and actual treatment owner per exchange; match route/form/state/year/geography and included packaging/transport |
| disclosure | plant site and reporting period; virgin natural mineral origin and each separately supplied aggregate grade; whole unmodified petroleum binder supply and actual grade; actual limestone filler and each whole preparation if present; explicit absence of external RAP or other recovered feed for this selected route; natural-gas rotary drying and separate hot screens/bins and pugmill; electric binder storage/line heating and actual dust-control configuration; actual supplied moisture and independent dry solids/free/absorbed water; whole fresh uncompacted mix at its measured temperature/time and phase or setting state; actual mixture specification and all applicable pre-release checks and authorization; calibrated unique net first-release wet mass Q and original cohort Q_c; opening/closing raw and WIP inherited exchange vectors; released FG stock and original shipments/returns without new production; observed postrelease service horizon h and actual incremental burden; manufacturer/spec permission and postwork tests/acceptance/disposition for any later work; China 1–35 kV user-side grid interface for adopted electricity; each real fuel/water phase and species-specific emissions with carbon origins; supplier-included package ingress and single upstream owner; new/old assets and parts with installed fluids and performed service; actual suppliers/receivers and independent unit conversions and uncertainty |

| rule_id | Applies to | Rule | source_ids |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| upstream_whole_supply | manufacture; assets; services | Start from actual burden-bearing whole receipts and declared supplier/inbound gates. Carry each whole formulation once; moisture, binder fractions and mineral assays are child accounts. Include any real incoming transport/service not already covered by the provider. Supplier-included packaging still has a physical ingress and exactly one upstream owner. Add every actually used omitted ingredient, preparation, fuel, water phase, package, test consumable, repair material, waste and measured species as its own card before completing a dataset; absence needs observed evidence, not a convenient zero. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004` |
| first_release_gate | manufacture; services | Q is the independently weighed net wet whole fresh mix uniquely first released after the actual required pre-release checks and authorization at the declared plant interface. Include all handling up to that actual release point. Record time, temperature, water and phase/setting state; record outstanding later tests and any release limitations honestly. Q includes closing already-released FG; do not add FG again as production or deduct its already-incurred manufacturing burden. Delivery/reinspection/rework never creates fresh Q. Samples removed before release and unaccepted failures are outside Q. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004` |
| complete_thermal_route | manufacture | Retain actual wet mineral receipts, each cold-feed grade, free/absorbed moisture and dryer load, burner and ventilation paths, hot screening/bin inventories, binder tank heels/circulation/actual electric heat, calibrated binder/filler/aggregate batching and complete pugmill cycle. Record actual control and release evidence without transferring historical source values as operating defaults. Internal returned fines keep their inherited vectors and cancel matched transfers once; they are not external recycled feed or a second purchase. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004` |
| cohort_vectors | manufacture; assets; services | Retain opening/closing raw, WIP, uninvoiced/unused supplies and per-exchange inherited vectors, not only mass fractions. Manufacturing closing vector stocks contain unreleased raw/WIP or genuinely unused/unassigned stores; they exclude released FG. Failed batches, idle, starts/stops, tests, cleanup, ordinary waste and its treatment remain in the proper cohort. Do not deduct stock-corrected consumption again. A burden transfer out needs a real independent other cohort/function and one justified handover; waste export or sale alone is insufficient. | `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
| postrelease_state | services | Keep original manufacture vectors and Q_c, actual gross shipments/returns and original-cohort incremental service over observed h. Aged/cooled/contaminated or returned mix has its actual state; no presumption that reheating or added binder restores it. Any actual postrelease work needs manufacturer/spec permission, added old/new materials and water/phase/mass evidence, postwork tests/acceptance and disposition. No second Q. Only unused/unassigned service or charge can carry forward; performed original-cohort service is not removed because FG stays in stock. This PCR uses first release; a net-delivery basis is a different method requiring original-delivery reversals and full stock burden, not an interchangeable denominator. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004`; `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
| gross_mass_and_phases | all processes | Reconcile gross wet physical masses independently of burden allocation. Keep external gas species, carrier mass, liquid/solid phases, old/new parts and full installed fluids with actual chemical identity. New repair material/water X_in and X_out are deduplicated only against other already-counted incoming/outgoing terms; a new inlet remains even when retained in full closing wet stock. Deduplicate assembly/component measures only once. The manufacturing and service physical gates below must combine exactly; no economic share scales gross mass. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004`; `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
| species_water_carbon | manufacture; services; assets | Separate full physical mass and relevant C/H/O/N/S and mineral-element balances from independently evidenced species and water origins. Drying is not proof of mineral calcination, reaction water or carbonation. Distinguish free, absorbed, structural and actual reaction water by independent evidence; never fit two unknowns to one residual. Separate actual mineral, fossil fuel/binder and ambient carbon. Keep NOx/SOx/VOC/TOC/COD and overlapping PM metrics as metrics until speciation/partition evidence exists; they cannot be relabelled as molecular masses. Actual missing core relationships make a concrete dataset inconclusive. | `epa-ap42-hma-2004`; `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual` |
| utility_and_asset_ownership | assets; manufacture; services | No boiler, steam, hot-oil heater, heat provider, compressor or refrigerant is presumed. If actual equipment/services differ, reassess this selected configuration and add each real fuel, carrier, water/condensate return, fluid charge and phase-specific loss. Purchased heat/steam has one provider owner with carrier mass, delivered enthalpy and supplier water/energy agreement; do not duplicate provider heat and onsite generation. Keep physical machine/liner/filter/old-fluid stock separate from the embodied service actually used, with no invented life or unit mass. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `epa-ap42-hma-2004`; `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
| package_six_legs | all packaging uses | For each actual packaging material/whole assembly, opening empty/attached WIP-FG/reusable stock + external plant purchase P + first non-purchased external ingress I + external returns received ER = corresponding closing stock + material departing with actual gross shipments S + external outward returns EO + waste W. Retain all six gross legs without economic scaling. Internal reuse cancels once and is not a new purchase, net-product Q or an automatic coproduct. P/I whole assemblies already include their measured components once; attached contents and water are child accounts deduplicated against other physical terms, never an excuse to omit true new ingress or full closing wet mass. | `fhwa-hma-inspectors-manual`; `jrc-ilcd-2010` |
| packaging_receipt_basis | packaging | For each actual whole packaging article, P records paid procurement (standalone or bundled, with or without a separate invoice). I records first non-purchased external ingress, including standalone gifts, loans, rental/pool issues and unpaid supplier-attached packaging; supplier attachment is only one I subset. ER requires the same item or an auditable matching batch linked to this site's own prior outward record; another party's prior use alone is not a return. P/I/ER are disjoint. The existing matching physical-article cards and raw subledgers cover these origins subject to every native material/form/state qualification; incompatible actual articles require their own atomic rows, never a substitute UUID. X_in/X_out remain separate measured material/water-change terms, not a substitute for whole-article receipt. Keep gross wet quantities, owner/custodian, payment/non-purchase basis, provenance, prior-outward links, actual state/unit and inherited manufacture/service vectors. A free receipt is neither a new manufacture nor automatically burden-free: attribute actual service and incremental transport/handling once to the proper original cohort/denominator and retain genuinely unused service separately, without a default lifetime or credit. Stock, physical gross legs and burden vectors remain separate. This is the declared conserving foreground-accounting implementation, not a claim that the cited source prescribes these variable names. | jrc-ilcd-2010 |
